_comment: The saved-session file format version, stamped by every writer and checked by
Why it exists: before this, a reader decided whether it understood a session
file by sniffing its shape (is `agents` an array?). That cannot tell 'this is
a newer format' from 'this is empty', and the two are treated very
differently — one must be left alone, the other is a fresh install. With
nightly prereleases and auto-update in play, installing a nightly and rolling
back to stable is a routine path, and a v2 file that still had an `agents`
array would have sniffed as readable and then been overwritten.
Contract: a reader accepts a file whose version is absent (pre-versioning,
fall back to shape) or <= its own. A HIGHER version means the file was
written by a newer build: the reader must refuse to overwrite it.
services/hub/cmd/brain/stores.go (Go). Bump this when the shape changes in a
way an older build cannot round-trip.
